response.original_title: [[Zipcar~Guide]] How do I escalate an issue with Zipcar? : Step-by-Step Escalation Process
response.overview: To escalate a problem with Zipcar, call their customer support ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US) and explicitly ask to be transferred to a supervisor or tier-two escalation team ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US). Steps to Escalate Your Issue Call Support: Dial Zipcar customer service ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US) and provide your itinerary or booking confirmation number right away ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US). Request a Supervisor: If the first agent cannot fix your problem, firmly ask to speak with a supervisor ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US) or the supervisory desk. Get a Case Number: Always ask for a specific case or tracking number so you can reference your complaint on future calls ☏+1-888-(402)-1586 (US). Use the App or Chat: Open the Zipcar App or online support chat to upload receipts, photos, or written proof of your issue
